en.bdb: The condition of the non-addicts or hollow scholars

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ਸੂਫੀ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: vedh kateb vakhaanadhe soofee hi(n)dhoo musalamaanaa|

en.bdb: Devoid of the love (of the Lord) Hindu and Muslim scholars describe the Vedas and the Katebas respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: musalamaan khudhai dhe hi(n)dhoo har paramesur bhaanaa|

en.bdb: Muslims are men of Allah and the Hindus love Hari (Visnu), the supreme god. Muslims have faith in Kalima, the sacred formula of Muslims, sunnat,

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਮਾਂ ਸੁੰਨਤ ਸਿਦਕ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇ ਜਨੇਊ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸੁਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: kalamaa(n) su(n)nat sidhak dhar pai janeuoo tilak sukhaanaa|

en.bdb: And circumcision, and Hindus feel comfortable with the flak, sandal paste mark and the sacred thread, janett

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਕਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਦਾ ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਦਾ ਹਿੰਦੁਵਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: makaa musalamaan dhaa ga(n)g banaaras dhaa hi(n)dhuvaanaa|

en.bdb: The pilgrimage centre of Muslims is Mecca and that of the Hindus Banaras situated on the bank of Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਜੇ ਰਖਿ ਨਿਮਾਜ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: roje rakh nimaaj kar poojaa varat a(n)dhar hairaanaa|

en.bdb: The former undertake rozas, fasts, and namaz, prayer, whereas the latter feel ecstasy (in their worship and fasts).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਮਜਹਬ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਘਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaar chaar majahab varan chhia ghar gur upadhes vakhaanaa|

en.bdb: They each have four sects or castes. Hindus have their six philosophies which they preach in every home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਪੀਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: musalamaan mureedh peer gur sikhee hi(n)dhoo lobhaanaa|

en.bdb: Muslims have the traditions of Murids and Pirs

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਇਕੋ ਰਹਿਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hi(n)dhoo dhas avataar kar musalamaan iko rahimaanaa|

en.bdb: Whereas the Hindus love to ten incarnations (of God), the Muslims have their single Khuda, Allah.
They both have in vain created many tensions.
